thread:
matt: Starting canary for service-router v3.4.1 -> eu-west, 10% traffic. Watch p95 <150ms and 5xx <0.5%.

deploy-bot: Canary started: id=canary-4450001111 target=service-router:v3.4.1 traffic=10% strategy=staggered-10m. Dashboard: https://deploys.redwood.internal/canary/4450001111 :robot_face:

ana: Monitoring slo-dashboard and traces. Will call out sustained drift.

luca: Early telemetry: embeddings-route p95 +50ms, kv_cache_hit_rate fell to ~57% from ~98%. No large 5xx yet.

jen: Noting a cluster-level 502 increase from kvcache group over last 90s, currently ~0.35% and rising. Tagging rollback candidate. @matt @ana

matt: Can we check request shape? If concentrated on long-seq (>1k tokens) we treat as cache churn. If 5xx >1% for 3m we trigger pause. No auto-rollforward.

ana: Traces show tail on long-seq embeddings and TTL lookup timeouts. I ran quick artifact diff vs v3.4.0: there is a new kvcache eviction heuristic in v3.4.1 and an attention prefetch tweak.

luca: Hypothesis: eviction heuristic causing churn. Suggest runtime bump `kvcache.window` from 2m->5m on canary to see if hit rate recovers.

matt: Do it. If p95 not under 150ms within 5m -> pause and rollback plan.

ana: Applied runtime flag on canary: `kvcache.window=5m`. Observing metrics.

observability-bot: Metric update: canary-4450001111 p95 -> 138ms within 3m after config change. 5xx down to 0.17%.

jen: Nice. Recommend keeping canary paused and running a 15m soak before resuming shift or doing a second canary without the heuristic.

matt: Agreed. Pause canary and soak 15m. Ana please add a short release note and open a PR for a follow-up patch (revert heuristic).

ana: Drafted note: "Interim: increase kvcache.window to 5m for long-sequence workloads due to eviction heuristic in v3.4.1; patch incoming." PR: https://git.redwood/release-notes/PR-1301

luca: Starting patch branch to revert eviction heuristic and run CI.

matt: We'll reconvene after soak and decide rollback vs targeted canary. Thanks team"
